why: Jack 2026-11-18: a figure dashing between the aisles (Scream-like), brief; rescued from the Flow gallery because the reference-copy guard wrongly rejected it
prompt:
Keep this shop-aisle photo as framed and lit, and add one thing way down the aisle, beside the dark back doorway: a tall, thin figure caught mid-dash from one side to the other, smeared by motion blur as if the camera barely caught it. It has no face, only smooth darkness where a face should be; its body is soot-black and cracked like old tarmac, a dull ember glow in the cracks, a trail of smoke dragged behind it. It is tiny and distant, half swallowed by shadow, a thing you would only notice on a second look. The shelves, the packets, the strip lights, the basket and the floor are unchanged, with the same grain and soft, faded colour.
Thanks.
